visual_checks.clipping_and_page_breaks: PASS: headings, captions, notes and footers contained on all pages; no stranded heading at page bottom; page 11 table fits intact.

findings.evidence: Kami flags short Chinese sheet titles as one-word orphan candidates. In the inspected pages these titles sit at the top with their introductory text and figures, not stranded at page bottoms.

findings.evidence: Public envelope specifications are distinguished from model-derived local dimensions; schematic internals and later headset-reference limitation are visible.
findings.disposition: Contract preservation satisfied; no factory-level fidelity claim inferred.

limitations: This is a document and visual review, not independent physical measurement or reproduction of all CAD/STEP/web verification. Saved technical audits were read as evidence.
